mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) nephrotoxicity may reduce renal clearance of sacubitril and its active metabolite LBQ657, increasing systemic exposure and hypotension risk, while sacubitril-induced vasodilation may potentiate aminoglycoside-related acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR, creatinine) closely at baseline and regularly during combination therapy; assess blood pressure and consider dose adjustment if renal function declines; ensure adequate hydration and avoid concurrent nephrotoxic agents when possible.
